name: ReadOut (local TTS)
head: Streaming synthesis into live playback implemented behind an off-by-default flag; real-audio proof pending
statusReason: A 25-item engineering and audio-pipeline assessment was completed on 2026-10-26. Item 1 (streaming playback) is implemented in tts_engine.StreamPlayer behind config streaming_playback (default off), exposed on /status, PATCH /config and the /control Settings tab, with 15 new unit tests passing alongside the existing suite. No real-audio run has been performed yet, so underrun behaviour on target machines is unmeasured and the default stays off.

evidence.note: Local pytest pass on Python 3.12 (unit + e2e; PowerShell tool tests skipped on macOS). GitHub Actions tests and package-smoke runs were in progress at record time.

streamingPlayback.scope: Kokoro chunks play through a sounddevice OutputStream as the generator produces them; sentence-aware split in streaming mode; stop and cloud playback abort the live stream; save waits for synthesis so saved_to stays in the response.
streamingPlayback.verification: python -m pytest passes locally on Python 3.12 (unit plus e2e; PowerShell release-tool tests skipped on macOS). Real audio, model download and underrun measurement are not covered by CI (docs/QA.md section 2b).
streamingPlayback.notDone: No pause/resume/seek, no server-sent events, no job queue, no cloud-engine streaming, no loudness normalisation.
streamingPlayback.nextAction: Run docs/QA.md section 2b against a real daemon on an M-series Mac and record underruns before answering SP-1.

nextStep.title: Prove streaming playback on real audio and answer SP-1
nextStep.why: The flag is implemented and unit-tested with fakes only; underrun behaviour and time to first audio on real hardware are unmeasured, so the default must stay off until measured.
nextStep.doneWhen: docs/QA.md section 2b passes on an M-series Mac with a ten-paragraph text: audible start within about one second, stop within one sentence, full-text WAV when saving, and /status.playback.underruns stays at 0; the result is appended to the brief and SP-1 is recorded in DECISION_LOG.md.

findings.title: Streaming playback implemented behind a flag; real audio unproven
findings.detail: StreamPlayer and _speak_streaming in tts_engine.py play Kokoro chunks as produced; 15 tests in tests/test_streaming_playback.py use a fake OutputStream and no numpy. No real daemon run yet.

findings.title: ElevenLabs voice names are sent as voice ids
findings.detail: engines/elevenlabs.py passes catalogue names such as Rachel into the /v1/text-to-speech/{id} URL; only the hardcoded default id works. Fix is part of assessment item 19.

findings.title: Accelerator never selected for Kokoro
findings.detail: KPipeline is built without a device argument, so Apple Silicon runs on CPU despite PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK in main.py. Assessment item 10.

findings.title: 24 further assessment items proposed
findings.detail: Pause/resume, SSE, job queue, word timestamps/captions, compressed export, loudness, device selection, ONNX, cache, languages, blending, lexicon, preprocessing, hotkeys, extension a11y, shared-secret auth, cloud streaming, model distribution, telemetry, audio regression harness, pyproject/lint, signing/updates, document ingestion.

phases.name: Phase 1: streaming playback (item 1)
phases.goal: Audio starts after the first sentence, behind a flag
phases.gate: docs/QA.md 2b passes on real hardware; SP-1 answered

phases.name: Phase 2: compounding items (2 to 25)
phases.goal: Build the next assessment item after a scoped brief
phases.gate: Each item has a brief, tests and a QA section before its flag flips

decisionsForDave: SP-1 [Open, 2026-10-26]: streaming playback default. A keep off until the real-audio harness measures underruns (recommended); B on for macOS only; C on everywhere. Unlocks a safe default flip.

SP-2 [Open, 2026-10-26]: save semantics while streaming. A wait for synthesis so saved_to stays in the /speak response (implemented, recommended); B return at once and expose the path via /status. Unlocks whether /control needs a second poll.

RO-NEXT [Open, 2026-10-26]: next assessment item. A item 2 pause/resume/position (recommended; builds on 1, unlocks 3 and 5); B item 19 cloud streaming and the ElevenLabs voice-id fix; C item 18 shared-secret auth. Unlocks the next brief.
verify: docs/QA.md section 2b on a real daemon
context: Local-first desktop TTS (Kokoro on-device, OpenAI and ElevenLabs optional). FastAPI on 127.0.0.1:7778, Chrome extension, /control browser panel as the macOS UI.
kickoffPrompt: Run docs/QA.md section 2b against a running ReadOut daemon with streaming_playback enabled on an M-series Mac, record time to first audio and /status.playback.underruns for a ten-paragraph text, and append the result to docs/BRIEF-streaming-playback.md under Observable acceptance.
unknowns: Underrun rate on CPU-only machines when a sentence synthesises slower than the previous one plays
Whether Kokoro chunk tensors land on an accelerator on any target (conversion handles cpu transfer but is untested there)
